questions.prompt: Which turn is the biggest scare card on Th 8h 3c?

choices.text: 7h, putting a third heart and a straight card out.

questions.explanation: The heart completes the flush and connects. Pairing the ten is a smaller change for the raiser.

questions.prompt: You were ahead with top pair. The turn completes the obvious flush and you have none. Your equity…

choices.text: Dropped against any calling range that had flush draws.
Only matters if you are all-in

questions.explanation: Draws that called the flop got there. Update the range before you barrel.

questions.prompt: A brick favors the player who…

choices.text: Already had the stronger made-hand range on the flop.
Missed every draw and has no pair

questions.explanation: When nothing completes, the flop leader is still the leader.

questions.prompt: Before the river, re-rank the hand because…

choices.text: The turn can change both the nuts and how many outs remain.
The dealer will tell you the winner

questions.explanation: A plan that ignores the turn card is a flop plan, not a turn plan.
